payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Schema and Eloquent Models Parity (M2.1-IMPLEMENT-001)
payload.objective: Request formal TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 1 of M2.1 (Schema and Eloquent Models Parity).
payload.explicit_request: M2.1 plan is approved and unit state is READY. Please issue the formal TASK_DISPATCH for M2.1-IMPLEMENT-001 (Slice 1: Schema and Eloquent Models Parity: 2026_09_12_000001 migration, R21MajorProjectCourseFile model, R21MajorProjectEvaluation model, and unit test). Provide exact instructions, constraints, and allowed_files.

payload.reason: M2.1 is READY, its dependency M1.1 is COMPLETED, and the working tree is clean. The approved first slice isolates persistence-layer parity before controller and endpoint work. The implementer is authorized to create or modify only the explicitly whitelisted migration, two Eloquent models, and their dedicated unit test.

task_dispatch.objective: Implement Slice 1 of M2.1: establish R21 Major Project database schema and Eloquent model parity with the legacy system, with dedicated automated verification.
instructions: Inspect the corresponding legacy migration and both legacy model definitions before implementation.
Inspect relevant existing CampusLynk migration and Eloquent model conventions before creating the target artifacts.
Create or update database/migrations/2026_09_12_000001_create_r21_major_project_tables.php to reproduce the required legacy schema while following target Laravel conventions.
Create or update app/Models/R21MajorProjectCourseFile.php with the correct table mapping, fillable attributes, casts, and relationships required by the legacy contract and target architecture.
Create or update app/Models/R21MajorProjectEvaluation.php with the correct table mapping, fillable attributes, casts, and relationships required by the legacy contract and target architecture.

Create tests/Unit/R21MajorProjectModelsTest.php covering model instantiation, table mappings, fillable/mass-assignment behavior, casts, required relationships, and schema/model parity that can be verified without requiring controller functionality.
Run the dedicated model test suite and PHP syntax checks for all changed PHP files.
Do not begin M2.1 controller, route, AttainmentService, frontend, or print-report implementation.
Return a TASK_REPORT containing changed files, implementation summary, tests and assertion counts, schema/model parity evidence, issues, and git working-tree status.
constraints: Only modify files in the approved allowed_files whitelist.
DO NOT modify app/Models/User.php or unrelated models.
DO NOT modify M2.2 or M2.3 frontend/view/print artifacts.
DO NOT execute destructive database operations.
DO NOT run migrate:fresh, db:wipe, DROP TABLE, or TRUNCATE.
Do not silently expand the schema beyond the verified legacy contract.
Do not introduce speculative relationships or attributes that are not supported by the legacy schema, existing target conventions, or the approved M2.1 analysis.
task_dispatch.expected_report: Implementation summary; exact changed files; legacy-to-target schema/model parity findings; model configuration and relationship verification; focused test result with test and assertion counts; PHP syntax results; any issues or deviations; git diff and working-tree status; confirmation that no files outside the whitelist were modified.
stop_conditions: Do not implement controller or route functionality.
Do not modify files outside the whitelist.
Do not execute destructive database operations.
Return TASK_REPORT for architectural verification before any checkpoint commit.
